goal: Ensure subtree merge commits can be reused directly on release branches
Saves maintainers from having to verify newly generated subtree merges on each backport branch
agreement: Approach NACK: adds bash maintenance overhead for a style preference verifiable via git log (maflcko)
Nonblocking objection: default behavior fails for users only checking subtree integrity (sedited)
Supports because enforcing backportability documents good practice and saves review effort (ryanofsky)
Verified by testing check behavior and the incompatible suppression flag (BrandonOdiwuor)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds repository lint checks to catch subtree updates that cannot be cleanly backported
Reduces reviewer effort by enabling verbatim merge commit reuse on maintenance branches
